meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_1F_2506, sat 15 May 2025). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: FIRST iGCSE (4MA1) paper in the audit. 4MA1 is NOT 1MA1 — 100 marks over 2 papers of 2 hours, both with a calculator. See docs/audit/25-igcse-4ma1-delta.md.

q16 tagged venn_diagrams, which data/courses.ts lists as HIGHER-ONLY. On 4MA1 Venn diagrams are Foundation content (spec 6.3 D) and this is a Foundation paper. The tag is correct for the question; the tier list is what disagrees, and it is a GCSE tier list. Do not 'fix' this by retagging.
q19(b),(c) tagged upper_and_lower_bounds, also HIGHER-ONLY in data/courses.ts, and also Foundation on 4MA1 (spec 1.8 C, 'identify upper and lower bounds'). Same situation as q16.

q23(b) tagged factorising_quadratics / solving_quadratic_equations_factorising. Quadratics ARE Foundation on 4MA1, limited by spec 2.7 A to x^2 + bx + c = 0 by factorisation. This question is what corrected an earlier claim in the delta doc that quadratics were Higher-only.

q1(c) tagged simple_arithmetic: forming the smallest/largest number from four digit cards is place value, which has no node of its own. Precedent in docs/coding-a-paper.md is to tag place value as decimals, but these are integers, so the lowest honestly-covering node is simple_arithmetic.

q10 tagged volume_of_a_prism: the mark scheme accepts either comparing volumes or dividing dimension by dimension. The volume route is the one the tag claims; the packing route is closer to spatial reasoning and has no node.
q12(b) tagged fractions_decimals_and_percentages rather than percentage_change: expressing one quantity as a percentage of another is not an increase or decrease.
q6(c) tagged sequences rather than finding_the_nth_term: the 12th term of 7, 11, 15, 19 is reachable by continuing the sequence, and sequences is the lower node.
